notes.title: Demo Now Available on Mac
notes.notes:
🐰 Bunny Hop Hop Demo Now Available on MacOS!
Featuring exclusive levels that are not in the full game.

Great news for Mac players—the Bunny Hop Hop demo is now live on MacOS! 🎉
(it includes the same special demo-only levels as the Windows version!)

These unique levels won't appear in the full game, so whether you're on Mac or Windows, this is your chance to experience something exclusive while helping shape the game.

We're still squashing bugs, so thank you for your patience—and your feedback is more than welcome! 💬
Let us know what you liked, what you didn’t, and of course, if you run into any bugs.

You can leave your feedback right here on Steam. Thanks for playing Bunny Hop Hop and being part of the journey!

notes.title: Fox Freeze!
notes.notes:
Enemies like the Evil Fox are out to stop you in [i]Bunny Hop Hop[/i]. One wrong move, and it’s game over!

Normally, touching an enemy means trouble. But what if, instead of running, you could make them helpless?

Grab a carrot to become invincible! While in this state, enemies that would normally take you down get stunned instead. Use it to your advantage, clear your path, and keep hopping forward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335782/e79c941d8c54ee5bc997a8e9fbbae417385846a5.gif[/img]

However, hails won’t be knocked out—but Bunny won’t get hurt by them either!

💣 Bomb weapons coming next! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Carrot POWER
notes.notes:
Okay so Bunny [i]loves[/i] carrots, but why you ask? 🥕 Well, they’re not just tasty—they give Bunny immunity against evil foxes, hails, and other bad guys. 
A true lifesaver during chaotic moments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335782/6fbe2929b2b1746f033cf15ce41fa90e35f385cb.gif[/img]

Plus, if you’re quick enough to grab them, carrots add extra points to your score!

This feature will officially be part of the demo! 🎉 Stay tuned for more updates :D

notes.title: New Enemy in the Works
notes.notes:
[b]Meet the Mischievous Monkey![/b]

This pesky new enemy is here to shake things up! He won’t hurt you, but he’s definitely going to make your journey more challenging. 

The Mischievous Monkey loves to meddle with your progress by changing the cubes' colors, forcing you to recolor them. But don’t worry—you can deal with him by jumping on him to send him packing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335782/d19119c1b7049c42ea9510a244a790f233bc18a4.gif[/img]
